name: @vanillagreen/pi-cbmem
description: codebase-memory-mcp as native Pi tools over MCP stdio: auto-index on connect, session project by default, no admin surface.

settings.label: Enable codebase memory
settings.description: Register the graph tools and start the codebase-memory server for this session. Disable and reload to remove the tool surface.

settings.label: Server binary
settings.description: Executable that serves the graph over MCP stdio. Name resolves from PATH; an absolute path pins a specific build.

settings.label: Project override
settings.description: Pin every query to this indexed project instead of deriving the name from the session working directory. Leave empty for per-workspace behaviour.

settings.label: Connect at session start
settings.description: Start the server when the session opens. The connection is what triggers auto-indexing and watcher registration for this project, so leaving it on keeps the graph fresh before the first query.

settings.label: Register admin tools
settings.description: Also register index_repository, delete_project, manage_adr, and ingest_traces. Off by default: the daemon indexes automatically and the rest are rare or destructive.

settings.label: Enabled tools
settings.description: Comma-separated allowlist of tool names, or the group name "admin". Empty registers the default query surface.

settings.label: Disabled tools
settings.description: Comma-separated tool names or group names to leave unregistered, applied after the allowlist.

settings.label: Request timeout
settings.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds; 0 disables it. A timeout is reported as a tool error and the connection stays up.

settings.label: Notify on server errors
settings.description: Show one warning when the server cannot start or dies. Tool errors are always returned to the agent.

author: vanillagreen
